name: Lancaster
gaps: Source query returned 13483 rows; 13416 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are LC_Parcels (countywide polygons + owner/sale) (https://services3.arcgis.com/rJcpRneDUBgTeCT3/arcgis/rest/services/LC_Parcels/FeatureServer/0). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Patriot View (~31436) is CAMA-rich but incomplete vs LC_Parcels (~56493) — do not use Patriot alone as countywide parcels.
No countywide FLU FeatureServer found; only Small_Area_Plan_Recommended_Land_Use (23 polys).
Municipal zoning companions (Kershaw, Heath Springs, Van Wyck) exist on LANCOGIS org — dig separately if city grain needed.
Assessor HTML: county departments + lancastersctax.qpaybill.com tax portal; qPublic App=LancasterCountySC 403 from research egress (may work in browser).
